scope: Only the 16 original dataset-srj18 sources; scan for lost SMT pad rotation, especially the trapezoid-to-rect fallback. No routing, layout changes, old traces/vias/pours, or other datasets.
method: Parse source S-expressions; map footprints by reference and transformed center, then pads by component, world center, and original pin hints. Compare the four corners of the rotated bounding rectangle to imported Circuit JSON pad geometry. Custom contour geometry is inventoried separately and not certified by this rectangle-rotation audit.
angleSemantics: KiCad pad positions are footprint-local; pad at.angle is absolute board orientation. The importer uses pad.at.angle for Circuit JSON ccw_rotation. Rectangle orientation is equivalent modulo180 degrees; quarter turns can be represented by swapped width/height.

importerSource.finding: The rect/roundrect and oval branches normalize rotation, but the unknown-shape fallback emits rect with unrotated size.x/size.y. Trapezoid reaches that fallback. This source inspection explains the observed pinned import; it is not a claim that this later commit generated the pinned files.

corrections.reason: Zero rect_delta makes the declared trapezoid an exact rectangle. Its absolute270degree pad rotation swaps width/height; imported fallback dropped that rotation. Preserve center, port identity, layers, aliases and all other obstacle fields.
